entry: Got the job offer today!!! I can't stop smiling. Called Mom and we both cried happy tears.
My flight got cancelled for the third time and the airline won't answer the phone. This is ridiculous.
Big presentation tomorrow. I keep checking my slides and my heart is racing. What if I forget everything?
Quiet Sunday. Read a book in the park, drank tea, nothing special. It was nice.
Our old dog Max passed away this morning. The house feels so empty.
